### Important safety information

### Lingo

* * * *

The Lingo Glucose System is intended for users 18 years and older not on insulin. It is NOT intended
for diagnosis of diseases, including diabetes.

The Lingo program does not guarantee that everyone will achieve the same results as individual
responses may vary. Consult your healthcare professional before making changes to your diet or
exercise regime or if you have an eating disorder or a history of eating disorders.

The product images are representative only.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# One Surmodics. One Team. Proven Performance.

#### Performance Coatings, Specialty Polymers, Manufacturing Services and In-Vitro Diagnostics

Surmodics helps medical device innovators solve complex material, coating, polymer, and
manufacturing challenges through integrated technologies and technical expertise. From early
feasibility through commercial manufacturing, we help customers improve device performance,
accelerate development, and reduce technical and regulatory risk.

From chemistry through commercial manufacturing, Surmodics brings together coatings, biomaterials,
specialty polymers, catheter technologies, analytical characterization, and manufacturing services
through one integrated partner helping customers accelerate innovation while reducing complexity.

[Contact Us][20]
47

years of coatings experience

4

feasibility and production centers

## **Performance, Precision, and Partnership Driven by Collaborative Talent**

Surmodics is built on nearly 50 years of coatings experience and strengthened by an expanded global
platform across the United States, Ireland, and Denmark. Today, customers can access biomaterials,
hydrophilic, hemocompatible, antimicrobial, drug delivery coatings and technologies, specialty
polymers, catheter solutions, analytical characterization, process development, scale-up, and
manufacturing support through one partner.

Surmodics is designed for teams that need:

[icon]
Coatings that have low particulates and high lubricity*
[icon]
Technical expertise brought in early enough to reduce rework
[icon]
Flexible engagement models aligned with your program
[icon]
Experience that understands how decisions affect development, manufacturing, and regulatory risk
[microscope image]

## **One Platform Built to Support Medical Device Performance**

Surmodics brings together coatings, biomaterials, specialty polymers, analytical services,
development expertise, and manufacturing support through one integrated partner. Whether a customer
needs a proven coating technology, a custom polymer, a coated device, testing support, or full
development and manufacturing services, Surmodics helps move programs forward with greater
confidence and reduces risk.

[

## Performance Coatings

][21]

Hydrophilic, hemocompatible, drug delivery and antimicrobial coating technologies designed to
improve medical device performance across the most demanding and tortuous parts of the body.

[

## Specialty Polymers

][22]

Custom biomaterials, hydrogels, monomers, and specialty polymer solutions that support advanced
medical device designs, drug delivery platforms, diagnostic applications, and next- generation
medical technologies.

[

## Coating Services

][23]

Process development, coating application, scale-up, manufacturing and technical support for
customers that need experienced execution from feasibility through commercial production.

[

## Analytical Testing Services** **

][24]

Analytical characterization, friction testing, particulate testing, microscopy, and performance
evaluation services that help customers understand coating behavior, troubleshoot issues, and reduce
development risk.

[

## In-Vitro Diagnostics** **

][25]

Materials, surface technologies, and development support for diagnostic platforms where precision,
consistency, and reliable surface performance are critical to assay and device function.

[

## CDMO

][26]

Integrated development, process optimization, scale-up, catheter technologies, and manufacturing
support designed to help customers move from concept to commercialization with a partner that
understands regulated medical device programs.

## **Where Expertise Meets Advanced Chemistry**

Our technology is only as strong as the people shaping it. The team blends scientific depth with
practical engineering experience, creating solutions that are precise, scalable, and ready for
commercial environments.

#### **Real-World Expertise**

Specialists experienced in hydrophilic chemistry, substrate behavior, and device-to-device
interaction.

#### **Innovation Backed by Experience**

A development culture focused on improvement, problem-solving, and engineering excellence.

#### **Material Versatility, Expertly Executed**

Coatings adapted for polymers, metals, and complex substrates like silicone, guided by experts who
understand material behavior.

#### **Performance You Can Trust**

Every solution is validated through rigorous testing by people committed to precision and
repeatability.

## Advanced Industrial Coatings

## Premium Industrial Coating Services • Stockton, CA • Serving OEMs Nationwide

Trusted partner for precision fluoropolymer coatings, powder coatings, nylon & specialty finishes
built for semiconductor, medical, food processing, energy, and automotive industries.

[
Get a Quote
][39]
[
Contact Us
][40]
Slide 1
Slide 1

### Why Choose AIC
* **Specialized Industrial Coating Provider** — We focus exclusively on coating application; we
  don’t compete with you on materials.
* **ISO / Certified / Audited** — ISO 9001-certified, DuPont® Star Coater, PPG Quality Approved
  Coater.
* **Engineering-Grade Performance** — High-performance coatings like PTFE, FEP, PFA, Halar® ECTFE,
  Rilsan® Nylon, Xylan®, epoxy/urethane, powder, dry-film lubricants, and more.
* **Nationwide & Precision Capabilities** — Serving medical, semiconductor, energy, automotive,
  defense, and industrial OEMs.
* **Scale & Facility** — Our 50,000 sq ft facility has conveyorized powder lines and
  climate-controlled zones for sensitive scientific/medical parts.

### Coating Capabilities
* **[PTFE, Fluoropolymer, Xylan® and Clyde Coatings][41]** — Nonstick, low friction, chemical & heat
  resistance
* **[Halar® ECTFE Coatings][42]** — Top-tier chemical resistance and corrosion protection
* **[Rilsan® Nylon Coatings][43]** — Ideal for wear, abrasion, chemical exposure, and engineered
  parts
* **[Powder Coatings][44]** — Durable finishes for structural or large parts across various
  industries
* **[Kynar PDVF Coatings][45]** — Ideal for extreme chemical exposure, UV durability, and
  long-lasting corrosion protection
* **[Fusion Bonded Epoxy Coatings][46]** — Perfect for pipelines and steel structures needing
  long-term corrosion, impact, and chemical resistance
* **[Cosmetic Liquid Class A Coatings][47]** — Designed for visible components requiring a flawless
  finish, toughness, and stable color over time

### Our Promise
* **On-time Delivery** — We understand the cost of downtime in manufacturing supply chains.
* **Quality & Traceability** — Complete documentation, coatings traceability, inspections, audits.
* **Engineering & Process Support** — Consultation on coating specifications, fixture design,
  masking, and post-process operations.
* **Scalable & Flexible** — From prototypes to large volume runs.
* **Cost-Optimized Solutions** — We help you choose coating systems that balance performance and
  cost.

## Industries We Serve

**[Medical & Life Sciences][48]**

Biocompatible coatings, sterilizable surfaces, precision components

**[Semiconductor & Electronics][49]**

Low-outgassing, dielectric coatings, wafer carriers, vacuum compatibility

**[Energy & Chemical][50]**

Corrosion protection, chemical-resistant linings, valves & piping

**[Automotive & EV][51]**

Wear-resistant and low-friction coatings, thermal barrier, sensor housings

**[Aerospace & Defense][52]**

Lightweight, high durability, thermal/chemical resistance

**[Food & Processing][53]**

FDA-compliant coatings, chemical & abrasion resistance

#### About AIC

Advanced Industrial Coatings is a leading US industrial coating services company, providing coating
applications for major US industrial, scientific and medical manufacturers. Our industrial coating
services help reduce cost, optimize supply chains, and improve conformance and quality. We apply a
range of high-performance, high-quality industrial coatings. AIC serves companies across the United
States and internationally. We are located in Stockton California.

950 Industrial Drive, Stockton, CA 95206 | [(209) 234-2700][54] | [contact@aic-coatings.com][55]

## Frequently Asked Questions

What makes Accentus Medical a leader in medical device coating?

Accentus Medical is a global pioneer in biocompatible surface technologies, offering clinically
proven coatings like Acusure®, Agluna®, and Acusure Ag®. Acusure® coating technologies are
specifically designed to achieve durable integration of cementless implants with host bone and soft
tissues. Agluna® and Acusure Ag® harness the power of antimicrobial silver ions to reduce the
incidence and severity of post-operative implant-related infection complications. These proprietary
technologies are targeted to ensure high performance and longevity of orthopaedic implants.

What is a medical device coating and why is it important?

A medical device coating is a specialized biocompatible surface layer applied to implants to achieve
implant durability and performance. Coatings are designed to enhance biocompatibility, wear
resistance, corrosion protection, and in some cases antimicrobial properties, enabling safety and
longevity of implantable devices. Learn more about advanced i[mplant coatings and materials.][36]

What materials are commonly used in medical device coatings?

Medical device coatings can be made from titanium and hydroxyapatite powders in order to promote
durable cementless integration with host bone. Antimicrobial silver ions are incorporated in order
to prevent growth of biofilm on implant surface and achieve a zone of bacterial inhibition around
the implant during the post-operative healing period.

## Innovation in Medical Technology

Accentus Medical is a leading medical technology company with over 20 years of expertise in the
commercial supply of clinically proven surface coating and modification technologies. Dedicated to
advancing the medical device industry, Accentus Medical combines cutting-edge research and
development with exceptional service. The team is renowned for its scientific expertise, extensive
medical device experience, and commitment to delivering high-quality, responsive solutions.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What makes Accentus Medical a leader in medical device coating?

Accentus Medical is a global pioneer in biocompatible surface technologies, offering clinically
proven coatings like Acusure®, Agluna®, and Acusure Ag®. Acusure® coating technologies are
specifically designed to achieve durable integration of cementless implants with host bone and soft
tissues. Agluna® and Acusure Ag® harness the power of antimicrobial silver ions to reduce the
incidence and severity of post-operative implant-related infection complications. These proprietary
technologies are targeted to ensure high performance and longevity of orthopaedic implants.

What is a medical device coating and why is it important?

A medical device coating is a specialized biocompatible surface layer applied to implants to achieve
implant durability and performance. Coatings are designed to enhance biocompatibility, wear
resistance, corrosion protection, and in some cases antimicrobial properties, enabling safety and
longevity of implantable devices. Learn more about advanced i[mplant coatings and materials.][36]

What materials are commonly used in medical device coatings?

Medical device coatings can be made from titanium and hydroxyapatite powders in order to promote
durable cementless integration with host bone. Antimicrobial silver ions are incorporated in order
to prevent growth of biofilm on implant surface and achieve a zone of bacterial inhibition around
the implant during the post-operative healing period.

## Innovation in Medical Technology

Accentus Medical is a leading medical technology company with over 20 years of expertise in the
commercial supply of clinically proven surface coating and modification technologies. Dedicated to
advancing the medical device industry, Accentus Medical combines cutting-edge research and
development with exceptional service. The team is renowned for its scientific expertise, extensive
medical device experience, and commitment to delivering high-quality, responsive solutions.

# **Medical Device Coating & Hemocompatibility Testing Company | Carlsbad, CA**

Alta Biomed helps medical device companies evaluate, develop, and test PzF thin-film antithrombotic
coatings for vascular and other blood-contacting devices.

## **Surface Technology for Blood-Contacting Devices**

Blood-contacting medical devices require careful attention to surface chemistry, coating integrity,
particulate risk, and hemocompatibility. Alta Biomed supports medical device developers with PzF
coating technology and testing services designed for vascular, catheter-based, implantable, and
other blood-contacting applications.

Our work helps customers evaluate whether PzF surface modification is feasible for their device, how
the coating performs after handling or simulated use, and how coated and uncoated devices compare in
development-stage blood-contacting test models.

### **Polyzene-F NanoCoating**

Polyzene-F, also known as PzF, is Alta Biomed’s thin-film polymer coating technology for medical
device surface modification. PzF can be evaluated on a range of vascular and blood-contacting
devices where surface chemistry, thrombus formation, coating integrity, and hemocompatibility are
important development considerations.

PzF coating programs are device-specific and may include surface preparation, coating application,
coating inspection, simulated use evaluation, acute particulate testing, and coated vs. uncoated
human blood loop testing.

## **Applications**

Alta Biomed supports PzF coating feasibility for vascular and blood-contacting medical devices
across a range of materials, geometries, and development stages.

Application areas include:
* Bare metal stents
* Covered stents
* Vascular grafts
* ePTFE grafts
* PET / polyester graft materials
* Structural Heart
* Catheter-based vascular devices
* Blood filters
* Embolic protection devices
* Thrombectomy devices
* Vascular access devices
* Anastomosis devices
* Implantable blood-contacting components
* PICCs
* LVADs
* Can load and elute drugs
* Anti-stick coating

To support the development of cutting-edge medical devices, Biocoat has added dedicated in-house
plasma capabilities. The use of plasma treatment supports the coating process by:
* Cleaning the surface to allow for maximum coating adhesion
* Functionalizing the surface to allow to enhance coating lubricity or durability performance
* Altering the surface to allow for unique coating enhancements

### How do I find a manufacturer for my product?

Finding the right manufacturer starts with knowing exactly what you need. Define your product
specifications, target price point, and required certifications before you begin outreach. From
there, search by product category on a B2B sourcing platform like Find My Manufacturer, where you
can filter manufacturers by certifications, minimum order quantity, location, and production
capability.

Cross-reference any manufacturer you find across multiple sources, review their profile for
verifiable details, and always request a sample before committing to a full production run.
Referrals from industry contacts and trade show connections can also surface manufacturers who do
not actively advertise online.

The sourcing process typically takes 4 to 12 weeks from first contact to confirmed partner,
depending on your product category and customization requirements.

### How much does it cost to work with a private label or contract manufacturer?

Manufacturing costs vary widely based on product category, order volume, customization level,
material inputs, and the manufacturer’s location. For private label products, costs generally
include a per-unit production fee, packaging and labeling costs, and in some cases a setup or
tooling fee for custom molds or packaging formats. For contract manufacturing, additional costs may
include formulation development, testing, and regulatory compliance depending on the product
category.

Most manufacturers set a minimum order quantity (MOQ) that directly affects your per-unit cost –
higher volumes consistently reduce the cost per unit. As a benchmark, supplement private label MOQs
typically start around 1,000 to 2,500 units, apparel manufacturers often start at 300 to 500 pieces
per style, and food manufacturing MOQs vary from 500 to 5,000 units depending on the format.

The most reliable way to understand real costs for your specific product is to submit quote requests
to multiple manufacturers and compare. Find My Manufacturer allows you to do this directly, free,
with no broker fees or commission

# ADVANCED MEDICAL DEVICE COATING SERVICE & CONTRACT MANUFACTURING SERVICES

Making the Tools of Medicine Run Smoother℠

At Formacoat, we specialize in providing Medical Device Contract Manufacturing Coating Services to
Biomedical Device Companies and Healthcare Device Companies. Leveraging a spectrum of Medical
Technology with a personalized approach, our expertise extends to coating a diverse range of Medical
Devices, including stents and catheters. With over 20 years of industry experience, we're your
trusted partner for Hydrophilic, Hydrophobic, and custom-specific coatings that enhance Biomedical
device performance and patient outcomes.

### государственной системы идентификации мобильных средств электрической связи


В соответствии со **статьей 6** Закона Республики Таджикистан "Об электрической связи" Правительство

государственной системы идентификации мобильных средств электрической связи (прилагается).

мобильных средств электрической связи в системе регистрации мобильных средств электрической связи
(далее - система) в нижеследующие сроки:
- с момента внедрения системы в течение 3 месяцев на пилотной основе бесплатно в автоматическом
режиме путем подключения (активизации) к сетям операторов мобильной связи;
- с момента окончания автоматической регистрации в течение 6 месяцев на пилотной основе бесплатно
через единый портал или другими способами, указанными в прилагаемом Порядке;

Республики Таджикистан "Об электрической связи" и прилагаемым Порядком.

июня 2020 года с привлечением частных инвестиций определить оператора системы согласно
законодательству Республики Таджикистан.
4. Службе связи при Правительстве Республики Таджикистан, Таможенной службе при Правительстве
Республики Таджикистан и соответствующим министерствам и ведомствам до 1 августа 2020 года привести
свои отраслевые нормативные правовые акты в соответствие с требованиями настоящего постановления.
5. Службе связи при Правительстве Республики Таджикистан и Комитету по телевидению и радио при
Правительстве Республики Таджикистан совместно с мобильными компаниями Республики Таджикистан

## ПОСТАНОВЛЕНИЕ

### О Порядке регистрации мобильных средств электрической связи и определение функций
### государственной системы идентификации мобильных средств электрической связи


В соответствии со **статьей 6** Закона Республики Таджикистан "Об электрической связи" Правительство
Республики Таджикистан постановляет:

1. Утвердить **Порядок** регистрации мобильных средств электрической связи и определение функций
государственной системы идентификации мобильных средств электрической связи (прилагается).
2. Регистрацию мобильных средств электрической связи производить по международным идентификаторам
мобильных средств электрической связи в системе регистрации мобильных средств электрической связи
(далее - система) в нижеследующие сроки:
- с момента внедрения системы в течение 3 месяцев на пилотной основе бесплатно в автоматическом
режиме путем подключения (активизации) к сетям операторов мобильной связи;
- с момента окончания автоматической регистрации в течение 6 месяцев на пилотной основе бесплатно
через единый портал или другими способами, указанными в прилагаемом Порядке;
- с момента окончания бесплатной регистрации на платной основе в порядке установленном Законом
Республики Таджикистан "Об электрической связи" и прилагаемым Порядком.
3. Службе связи при Правительстве Республики Таджикистан в целях реализации настоящего Порядка до 1
июня 2020 года с привлечением частных инвестиций определить оператора системы согласно
законодательству Республики Таджикистан.
4. Службе связи при Правительстве Республики Таджикистан, Таможенной службе при Правительстве
Республики Таджикистан и соответствующим министерствам и ведомствам до 1 августа 2020 года привести
свои отраслевые нормативные правовые акты в соответствие с требованиями настоящего постановления.
5. Службе связи при Правительстве Республики Таджикистан и Комитету по телевидению и радио при
Правительстве Республики Таджикистан совместно с мобильными компаниями Республики Таджикистан
обеспечить проведение широкой разъяснительной работы среди населения.

## Improving interactions of
## surfaces with the body

Since 2004, ISURTEC® has been an industry leader in the modification of surfaces.
Driven to innovate and fueled by a deep reservoir of experience, our biofriendly coatings have
contributed to the safety and performance of over 100 medical devices. 

## ISURTEC® Solutions

### Medical Device Coatings

ISURGLIDE hydrophilic coatings decrease friction for medical devices, reducing tissue damage for
minimally invasive procedures. Sold commercially and used on FDA-approved devices since 2007.

### In Vitro Technology

Our coatings control the interaction of cells and biomolecules at the surface and can be used in
microfluidics and cell tissue engineering applications.

### Services

From contract research and laboratory services to feasibility studies, coating optimization and
custom coating development ISURTEC works with you to accelerate your success.

We look forward to collaborating with you to accelerate your success.

# Global leader in surface technologies & advanced materials

At Oerlikon, we engineer innovative technologies and solutions that make our customers' products
last longer, perform better, and generate less waste. Our high-tech surface solutions and advanced
materials are designed for applications in the most demanding industries.
About us
We make products better with our integrated offering of advanced materials, coating equipment and
services, and component manufacturing. Our global network of highly skilled engineers and problem
solvers is combined with a strong local presence, ensuring we are always close to our customers.


1
Oerlikon at the bottom of the sea

Oerlikon makes metals ready for the deep sea: coatings and materials protect drill bits, valves,
pumps and seals against pressure, corrosion and wear. This increases reliability, lowers costs and
helps protect sensitive underwater environments.

[ Read the full story ][92]
2
Taking off safely and efficiently

From turbines to landing gear, Oerlikon technologies help make aircraft safer, more efficient and
more economical. Our coatings, superalloy components and 3D printed parts protect metal alloys
against extreme heat and loads, supporting the next generation of sustainable aviation.

[ Read the full story ][93]
3
High performance for high performance

Semiconductors power everything from smartphones to cars and AI data centers. Oerlikon supports the
industry with coatings, thermal interface materials and 3D printed components that protect chip
production equipment, improve heat management and help manufacturers push the limits of performance.

[ Read the full story ][94]
4
Sustainable, durable and safe mobility

Oerlikon supports the automotive industry with solutions that make mobility safer and more
sustainable. Our technologies protect battery systems, reduce weight, lower friction and improve
manufacturing efficiency, helping both drivers and manufacturers.

Heal better, recover faster

best-in-class results.

Advanced materials

designed to withstand pressure, heat, and wear.
Highly specialized components
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments.

surgical, electrosurgical and medical products.

Fully-Automated Coating Systems

Our medical device coating services come with industry-leading accuracy, precision & repeatability.

Virtual Masking™

Our proprietary Virtual Masking™ system is built with state-of-the-art technology created by our

##### ABOUT US

## Redefining the Boundaries of Biocompatibility

### Bio-Atomic Deposition

Our Cold Atmospheric Plasma technology covalently bonds bioactive molecules to surfaces without
using harsh chemicals or heat.

### Scalable Integration

into existing medical and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

##### Understanding theradep

## Frequently Asked Questions

How does TheraDep’s Cold Atmospheric Plasma (CAP) process work?

Our BioDep™ technology uses low-temperature plasma to energize bioactive molecules, allowing them to
form strong, covalent bonds with a surface in a single dry step at room temperature.

What types of materials and biologics can be coated?

The process is highly versatile and can apply proteins, peptides, and pharmaceuticals to virtually
any substrate—including metals, polymers, and ceramics—without damaging heat-sensitive materials.

Do these coatings require chemical binders or glues?

No, the CAP process eliminates the need for polymer binders or harsh chemical linkers, resulting in
an ultra-pure coating consisting solely of the active therapeutic or biologic material.

##### Understanding theradep

## Frequently Asked Questions

How does TheraDep’s Cold Atmospheric Plasma (CAP) process work?

Our BioDep™ technology uses low-temperature plasma to energize bioactive molecules, allowing them to
form strong, covalent bonds with a surface in a single dry step at room temperature.

What types of materials and biologics can be coated?

The process is highly versatile and can apply proteins, peptides, and pharmaceuticals to virtually
any substrate—including metals, polymers, and ceramics—without damaging heat-sensitive materials.

Do these coatings require chemical binders or glues?

No, the CAP process eliminates the need for polymer binders or harsh chemical linkers, resulting in
an ultra-pure coating consisting solely of the active therapeutic or biologic material.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.
